title: Interactive Talking NPC with Branching Choices
code_qedit:
; Function 200: Called when player interacts with NPC (param5 = 200)
200:    window_msg 'Hunter, the Forest is dangerous!\nWill you assist us?'
        winend
        list R100, 'Yes, I\'m ready!\tNot right now.'
        jmp_on 201, R100               ; If R100 != 0 (Option 1 selected), jump to 201
        
        ; Option 0 (Yes) Branch:
        window_msg 'Excellent! The gate is unlocked.\nProceed with caution.'
        winend
        unlock_door2 0001, 0005        ; Unlock Switch 5 on Floor 1 (opens door)
        ret

201:    ; Option 1 (No) Branch:
        window_msg 'Come back when you are prepared.'
        winend
        ret
code_newserv:
; Function 200: Called when player interacts with NPC (param5 = 200)
200:    window_msg "Hunter, the Forest is dangerous!\nWill you assist us?"
        winend
        list r100, "Yes, I'm ready!\tNot right now."
        jmp_if_true 201, r100          ; If r100 != 0 (Option 1 selected), jump to 201
        
        ; Option 0 (Yes) Branch:
        window_msg "Excellent! The gate is unlocked.\nProceed with caution."
        winend
        set_switch_flag_sync 1, 5       ; Unlock Switch 5 on Floor 1 (opens door)
        ret

201:    ; Option 1 (No) Branch:
        window_msg "Come back when you are prepared."
        winend
        ret
explanation: Pairs window_msg with winend (never mesend). The list opcode displays a multi-choice prompt, writing the 0-based selected index into register R100.

title: Quest Victory & Guild Objective Completion
code_qedit:
; Function 300: Objective Victory Transition
300:    leti R255, 00000001            ; Set Quest Success Flag (R255 = 1)
        play_se2 00000000              ; Play Quest Victory Fanfare
        window_msg 'Quest Objective Complete!\nReturn to the Hunter\'s Guild for reward.'
        winend
        ret
code_newserv:
; Function 300: Objective Victory Transition
300:    leti r255, 1                   ; Set Quest Success Flag (R255 = 1)
        play_se2 0                     ; Play Quest Victory Fanfare
        window_msg "Quest Objective Complete!\nReturn to the Hunter's Guild for reward."
        winend
        ret
explanation: R255=1 signals the Guild and server that the primary objective has succeeded, unlocking the completion reward. Play_se2 0 plays the official PSO quest victory fanfare.

title: Function 0 Master Quest Entry & Initialization
code_qedit:
; Function 0: Quest Entry Point
0:      set_epiII 00000001              ; Set Episode 1 (Resets floor config)
        BB_Map_Designate 00, 0000, 00, 00 ; Floor 0 = Pioneer 2 City
        BB_Map_Designate 01, 0001, 00, 00 ; Floor 1 = Forest 1
        initial_floor 00000000          ; Start players on Floor 0
        unknown04 100                   ; Spawn background monitor thread (Function 100)
        ret

; Function 1: Blank callback (ret only)
1:      ret
code_newserv:
; Function 0: Quest Entry Point
0:      set_episode 1                   ; Set Episode 1 (Resets floor config)
        bb_map_designate 0, 0, 0, 0     ; Floor 0 = Pioneer 2 City
        bb_map_designate 1, 1, 0, 0     ; Floor 1 = Forest 1
        initial_floor 0                 ; Start players on Floor 0
        thread 100                      ; Spawn background monitor thread (Function 100)
        ret

; Function 1: Blank callback (ret only)
1:      ret
explanation: Every PSOBB quest begins execution at Function 0. Calling set_episode resets floor maps, so BB_Map_Designate must immediately follow. Function 1 is reserved by project convention as ret-only for blank callbacks.

title: Encounter Wave & Room Clearance Monitor Thread
code_qedit:
; Function 100: Spawned as a background thread by Function 0
100:    wait_vsync                     ; Mandatory yield (never loop without wait_vsync!)
        leti R10, 00000001             ; R10 = Floor 1
        leti R11, 00000004             ; R11 = Room 4
        if_zone_clear R12, R10         ; Checks Floor R10, Room R11 -> writes result to R12
        jmp_off 100, R12               ; If R12 == 0 (not clear), keep waiting
        
        ; Encounter cleared:
        unlock_door2 0001, 0008        ; Open exit door (Switch 8 on Floor 1)
        play_se1 0000000C              ; Play switch activation chime
        ret
code_newserv:
; Function 100: Spawned as a background thread by Function 0
100:    sync                           ; Mandatory yield (never loop without sync!)
        leti r10, 1                    ; r10 = Floor 1
        leti r11, 4                    ; r11 = Room 4
        if_zone_clear r12, r10         ; Checks Floor r10, Room r11 -> writes result to r12
        jmp_if_false 100, r12          ; If r12 == 0 (not clear), keep waiting
        
        ; Encounter cleared:
        set_switch_flag_sync 1, 8      ; Open exit door (Switch 8 on Floor 1)
        play_se1 12                    ; Play switch activation chime
        ret
explanation: Monitors room encounter clearance without locking the client. if_zone_clear consumes two consecutive registers: the specified register (floor) and specified register + 1 (room). It yields every frame with sync / wait_vsync.
